frozen_domain: same 15 GPHP roots and root-reachable residual domain used by AH/AI; no post-outcome family changes
closure_objective: For every reachable residual F already in the AI signed-incidence class, determine whether there exists at least one polynomially enumerable signed-incidence-admissible exact-DP pivot whose exact DP plus cheap policy replay either terminates or lands in another residual in the same signed-incidence class under the same frozen root budget.
candidate_selector: Enumerate variables only. For each variable x compute the pair-enumeration-free local signed-incidence raw-mass upper bound S-M_x+(b_x*A_x+a_x*B_x-a_x*b_x). A pivot is envelope-admissible iff that upper bound is <= T=min(floor(B/2),floor(sqrt(B*(V-1)))). Among self-preserving candidates choose lexicographically by (local_bound,var).
truth_firewall: SAT truth is forbidden for candidate generation, pivot selection, or closure membership. Known GPHP UNSAT may be used only as post-selection terminal semantic validation.
nonclaim: A finite closure pass is not a universal proof that all arbitrary-CNF reachable residuals enter or remain in the signed-incidence class. Universal symbolic closure remains open unless separately derived.
